# Rack & Stack Storage Systems

> Rack & Stack Storage Systems Pvt. Ltd. designs, manufactures, supplies and
> installs industrial storage systems — pallet racking, cantilever racking,
> slotted-angle shelving, heavy-duty long-span racks and in-plant material
> handling equipment — planned around a building, its loads and the way a team
> works.

Rack & Stack is a storage systems manufacturer and exporter. Every project
starts with a site survey and a bay-by-bay storage plan, then moves through
engineering and design, manufacturing, installation and final handover.

## Key pages

- [Products](/products): product categories and individual storage systems.
- [Services](/services): storage planning, site surveys, installation and
  project coordination.
- [Industries](/industries): storage systems planned for specific industries.
- [Projects](/projects): published case studies of delivered installations.
- [Insights](/blog): practical guides for teams planning warehouse storage.
- [Request a Quote](/request-a-quote): start a storage plan or quote.
- [Contact](/contact): phone, email and address details.

## Notes

- Products, specifications and metadata are managed through the site's admin
  and content system.
- Admin routes under `/admin` and API routes under `/api` are not intended for
  crawlers.
